bpjs_ir2025_jmo_users.note: The prose above this table on the same page (PDF p.99, left column) calls the 2025 figure the registered participants using the JMO app, counted up to the 2025 reporting period ('hingga periode pelaporan tahun 2025 tercatat jumlah peserta terdaftar pengguna aplikasi JMO'). The row is therefore read as running totals of registered users, not users active within each year; reading the 2024 and 2023 columns the same way is an inference from the shared row. That sentence also prints a year-on-year growth of '(41,5%)' and the count as '33.682.397 juta'; both disagree with the table (its own 2025 and 2024 values do not give that growth, and 'juta' after a full count is a unit slip), so the post uses the table values only and never that 41.5% or '33.682.397 juta'. The sentence is interleaved with the next column in the stored -layout text, so it is described here, not quoted.
